name: RPTOR independent companion of MTOR complex 2
pathways: regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction
positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction

function.text: RICTOR encodes rapamycin-insensitive companion of mTOR. Annotated molecular activities include enzyme-substrate adaptor activity and molecular adaptor activity. It participates in regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction and positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.
